reason: Westchase is right by Hillcroft where I already go on weekends, and being able to try on and get the length checked fixes my main problem with ordering online. I'd stop in, probably grab an everyday abaya and a couple of hijabs with the 15% off, but I'm not dropping $120 on a jalabiya set with no Eid coming up.
objection: Online stuff always comes up short on me or looks cheaper than the video. If the abayas run short or the fabric feels thin when I touch it, I'm walking out with just a hijab.
